comparison.note: Per-control region comparison avoids comparing the concept's 59px rail against a 44px runtime rail.
comparison.reference_top: Unretouched concept region crops, Lanczos downsampled to 44px control height (checkboxes 32px).
comparison.runtime_bottom: Same positions, widths and heights, composed exclusively from decoded runtime assets; labels added by preview_text.ps1.

hud.material_method: Derived from the approved source-based runtime textures: original corner facets and bevels, repeated horizontal/vertical stretch samples; fill luminance remapped to neutral grayscale; gold tint of the same metal for slider core. No new generated atlas.

preview.composition: Decoded new runtime assets; only local Fira Sans labels and a heart placeholder are added by hud_preview_text.ps1.

preview.labels: preview_text.ps1 overlays local Fira Sans SemiBold/Bold only

seam_summary.criterion: All 6x44 actual RGBA pixels of the assembled rib match the source-derived common reference in every state combination.

source.method: Direct source pixels; fixed 16px bevel zones, vertical remapping of text-free profiles, horizontal column repetition. No regenerated or redrawn material.

differences: Stretch-center columns are identical; field center is vertically constant.
The right gold end cap mirrors the original left gold cap; hover end caps reuse original silver corner facets.
Shared six-pixel ribs remain neutral across all states.
Preview text uses local Fira Sans SemiBold with the requested stronger 4px contour.
visual_review.review: Reviewed the actual final comparison at identical per-control sizes, plus the 1152px page and 4x nearest seam crop. Wide silver bevels and corner planes, gold inset relief, original blue and brown vertical gradients, bright raised hover, and wider recessed checkbox frames are visibly retained. The six-pixel rib uses an actual broad source metal plane instead of hairlines.
